CustomField.description: List of Functional Groups who should not received the GetFeedback survey on closed cases.
CustomField.formula: IF(OR( /* Check to see if the Case is not "Closed: Resolved"*/ NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status,"Closed: Resolved")), IsClosedOnCreate == TRUE, /* Check to see if the case has been closed for more than 14 days */ TODAY()-DATEVALUE(ClosedDate) > 14, /*Check to see if the Case is associated with a Functional Group that should be excluded */ CC_Functional_Group__r.Name = "Admission Services", CC_Functional_Group__r.Name = "Educational Outreach and Student Services", CC_Functional_Group__r.Name = "Enterprise Marketing Hub", CC_Functional_Group__r.Name = "ESM Online", CC_Functional_Group__r.Name = "External Unit", CC_Functional_Group__r.Name = "First in the World Grant", CC_Functional_Group__r.Name = "Office of the President", CC_Functional_Group__r.Name = "Office of the University Provost", CC_Functional_Group__r.Name = "Student Success Innovations", CC_Functional_Group__r.Name = "ASU Salesforce Support", CC_Functional_Group__r.Name = "ASU Advisor Outreach", CC_Functional_Group__r.Name = "ASU Coach Outreach", CC_Functional_Group__r.Name = "Enrollment Analysis", CC_Functional_Group__r.Name = "Dean of Students", ISBLANK(TEXT(Functional_Group__c)), /*Check for Origin Chat and exclude */ ISPICKVAL(Origin__c , "Chat"), /*Check for Origin Record Review AND FG name CISA */ AND( (ISPICKVAL(Origin__c , "Record Review")) , (CC_Functional_Group__r.Name = "Integrative Sciences and Arts")), /*Check for Origin Web AND FG name Financial Aid */ AND( (ISPICKVAL(Origin__c , "Web")) , (CC_Functional_Group__r.Name = "Financial Aid")), /*Check Contact Email and exclude */ Contact.Email ="dse_na2@docusign.net", Contact.Email ="autogenerated@asu.edu", Contact.Email ="registrar@asu.edu", Contact.Email ="graduation@asu.edu", Contact.Email ="gfa-reg@asu.edu", /*Check to see if the Case is associated with a Category that should be excluded */ CONTAINS(TEXT(Category__c), "Recruitment"), CONTAINS(TEXT(Sub_Category__c), "Recruitment"), CONTAINS(TEXT(Category__c), "Outreach")), /* If any of the above is true, display nothing.*/ "", /*Else, check to see if the feedback has been provided*/ IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Case_Survey_Received_Date__c)), /*If feedback has been provided, display that message*/ "You have already provided feedback on this case. Thank you.", /*Else, show the Link. Note that the "_blank" parameter "Displays link in a new unnamed window."*/ "Take a " + HYPERLINK("https://asu.getfeedback.com/r/fWD3ZfaE?Case_ID="&Id&"&name="&Contact.FirstName,"survey","_blank") + " to tell us how we did."))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: List of Functional Groups who should not received the GetFeedback survey on closed cases.
CustomField.label: Feedback Link
